abstract: Three tall, phenotypic female siblings with XY gonadal dysgenesis were found to have short fourth metacarpal bones (bilateral in two and unilateral in the other). Clitoromegaly was observed in the two older siblings, without hirsutism. Bilateral streak gonads were found in all three. A gonadoblastoma was present in the left streak gonad of the youngest, and an adenomatoid tumor in the left streak gonad of the oldest, who was diabetic. Determination of androgens from peripheral and gonadal venous plasma revealed androgen secretion by the streak gonads. On the basis of clinical findings, familial tendency, and androgen secretion from the streak gonads in these patients, it is proposed that the XY gonadal dysgenesis represents a severe form of male pseudohermaphroditism.
abstract_ja: 三姉妹で、いずれも身長が高く表現型は女性である、XY型性腺異形成を認めた。第4中手骨が短く（三姉妹のうち二人は両側性、残る一人は片側性）、年長の二人には陰核肥大がみられたが多毛はなかった。三人とも両側性に線状性腺を認めた。最年少者の左側線状性腺には性腺芽腫、年長者（糖尿病あり）の左側線状性腺には腺腫様腫瘍が存在した。末梢静脈血と性腺静脈血のアンドロゲン測定により、線状性腺からのアンドロゲン分泌が明らかになった。臨床所見、家族内発症傾向、線状性腺からのアンドロゲン分泌に基づき、XY型性腺異形成は男性仮性半陰陽の重症型を表すと考えられる。
